children: RNS Number : 7224T  Aberdeen Asian Income Fund Limited  07 September 2026

Pursuant to Listing Rule 6.4.9, the Company announces that Martin Rowley, who is a non-executive director of the Company, will be appointed as a non-executive director of EJF Investments Ltd to take effect on the later of 1 October 2026 or the date on which the Jersey Financial Services Commission confirms that it has no objection to such appointment.
